# Project knowledge

`PROJECT_BRIEF.md` is the entry point for every role: it names the project's research fields, method, data and known risks, code and quality gates, documents and manuscript, out-of-scope folders, current phase and source tiers. Any digests of the project's code, data and documents that help a role start quickly also live here. If a number in a digest or the brief disagrees with its source file, the source file wins and the discrepancy is logged in `02_findings_ledger/FINDINGS.md`. The Findings & Records Curator maintains this folder; the Research Project Manager keeps the current-phase section up to date, and the Academic Supervisor approves any change to scope.
